title: KeenTouchstone JudgeCalibration
description: The judge's exam record and license (SPEC 3b concretized in v0.2). Computed ONLY against human-confirmed labels (anti-circularity: human_label_source is structurally pinned to 'human'). An EvalVerdict with scorer_kind=model_graded must reference a calibration whose status is JUDGE_LICENSED; NEEDS_HUMAN blocks CI promotion. $id is a placeholder.

judge_id.description: Identity of the judge under examination (scorer id / name).

judge_prompt_hash.description: Hash of the judging prompt/config — a changed prompt is a NEW judge needing a new license.

anchor_set_ref.description: Path/URI of the anchor set used for the exam.

human_label_source.description: Anti-circularity, structurally enforced: kappa may only be computed against human-confirmed labels. Auto-generated labels may EXPAND an eval set but may never certify the judge.

prevalence.description: Base rate of PASS among human labels. Surfaced because of the kappa paradox: at extreme base rates kappa can be low despite high raw agreement — read kappa TOGETHER with TPR/FPR and prevalence.

kappa.description: Cohen's kappa vs human labels (never raw %-agreement alone). NULL when anchor_n_items < thresholds.min_items — below ~30 labels a point estimate is misleading (calibration unreliable), per the Anthropic 20-50-real-failures floor.

tpr.description: Judge sensitivity: P(judge says pass | human says pass).

fpr.description: P(judge says pass | human says fail) — the dangerous direction: rubber-stamping failures.

abstention_rate.description: 'Unknown' is a legal judge answer; abstentions are excluded from kappa and counted here. High abstention is surfaced in reasons.

alt_test.description: The alternative annotator test (ACL 2025, arXiv 2501.10970): may this LLM replace the human annotators? Requires >= 3 human annotators; inapplicable is reported honestly, never computed anyway.

reason.description: Why inapplicable (e.g. fewer than 3 human annotators).

epsilon.description: Cost-benefit margin favoring the LLM (paper's hyperparameter).

thresholds.description: The gate's contract, recorded so a license is auditable.

kappa_licensed.description: Minimum kappa for JUDGE_LICENSED (default 0.6 'acceptable' per Landis-Koch; 0.8 = strong).

min_items.description: Minimum human-labeled items before a kappa point estimate is shown at all (default 30).

max_abstention.description: Abstention rate above which the judge cannot be licensed.

reasons.description: Plain-language grounds for the status (too few items, kappa below threshold, high abstention, kappa-paradox caveat, ...).
